title: Daak Khana
overview: Set between two connected Haryana villages, Dakhkhana follows a post office that's more than a building; it's the pulse of relationships. When Anjali, a young city-bred post officer, arrives, she becomes the centre of attention. As love grows between her and Akash, a powerful rival, Cheena, turns ego into revenge by trying to shift the post office, sparking a fight for love, dignity, and pride.
